headline: Worth Peripherals Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Worth Peripherals Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of Equity Shares of Worth Wellness Private Limited (Wholly‐owned Subsidiary of the Company) by the Company via Conversion of loan into equity.
